title: The Protector
description: Add a BOSS, named The Protector and stuff bout him
body:
Add "Protector" a boss which drops a surprise when defeated ! 
He can spawns randomly in : 

- Birch Forest
- Dark Forest
- Plains biome


As a Human, he can spawn even during the day, be careful while exploring !
Don't forget that he is a Hunter, The Protector is strong !
